note: 8bitcn.com — 8-bit themed shadcn registry. /docs/components/<name> (57 pages) is one component's docs page; /docs/blocks/<category>/<name> (62 pages over the 15 categories listed) is one block and the slug is the registry item name (audio-settings, login-form-with-image, hero1, …). The <category> pages themselves (/docs/blocks/calendar, /docs/blocks/advanced, …) are listings and the top-level tool pages (/character-sheet, /profile-creator) are not components, so neither shape is in match. 119 of 121 items get a url; profile-card and login-form-2 have no page under their name (player-profile-card and login-form exist instead). robots: no rules.
